tax.text: He introduced legislation for a nationwide monthly refundable tax credit for young adults.
tax.quote: That’s why I’m proud to introduce the Young Adult Tax Credit and establish a national program that invests in our upcoming generations

wages.text: He supports raising the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour and strengthening workers’ rights to organize and bargain collectively.
wages.quote: I support increasing the federal minimum wage to $15/hour, and then indexing the minimum wage to inflation so that workers don’t start falling behind the moment they get a raise.

trade.text: He criticized tariffs on Canada and Mexico, saying they would raise prices and threaten Kentucky jobs.
trade.quote: President Trump promised to lower prices, but these tariffs will do the opposite, increasing the cost of food, automobiles, and gas for every American family.

debt.text: He joined a letter opposing cuts to Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid benefits and access.
debt.quote: We write to oppose any attempts to cut access or benefits to the vital programs that Americans rely on, such as Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid.

schools.text: He has advocated for public schools, public education employees, and expanded public education programs.
schools.quote: Every kid should have the opportunity to go to a good public school that prepares them for a successful life, no matter your zip code.

safety.text: He requested funding for community-based gun violence prevention and a Louisville group violence reduction and reentry project.
safety.quote: Community Project: Louisville Group Violence Reduction ReEntry Project

immigration.text: He supports comprehensive immigration reform with a broad pathway to citizenship and opposes shifting federal immigration enforcement to local police.
immigration.quote: A broad path to citizenship must be the centerpiece to any serious immigration reform that moves 11 million people out of the shadows.

guns.text: He has called for universal background checks and cosponsored bills to expand background checks and restrict assault weapons.
guns.quote: Let’s start with universal background checks. 90 percent of the American public wants us to have background checks to buy a firearm in this country.

gender.text: He criticized Kentucky's ban on transgender students participating in sports and pledged to protect LGBTQ Americans' rights and safety.
gender.quote: Republicans passed a bill that disallows trans kids from participating in sports right here at home in Kentucky.

cannabis.text: As a state senator, he co-sponsored an omnibus bill providing for regulated cannabis sales, taxation, and licensing.
cannabis.quote: apply the excise tax beginning on July 1, 2023, and allow cannabis sales beginning on July 1, 2024

health.text: He supports Medicare for All and expanding health coverage, including through Medicaid and Medicare drug price negotiation.
health.quote: That’s why I support Medicare for All to ensure that everyone is covered with quality, affordable, accessible care.

energy.text: He supports a federal clean energy standard and public investment and incentives to expand renewable energy and reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
energy.quote: I support a federal clean energy standard that incentivizes investor-owned electric utilities to achieve greenhouse gas emissions reductions while creating millions of good-paying jobs to build the clean energy infrastructure necessary to make this transition.

voting.text: He supports expanding absentee and early voting, same-day registration, automatic registration, and ballot drop boxes.
voting.quote: We must expand absentee voting, allow for automatic voter registration, same-day voter registration, allow for early voting and ballot dropboxes to make it more convenient for more people to vote, and make election day a federal holiday.

tax.text: Her campaign lists lower taxes as one of its priorities.
tax.quote: Defending Capitalism Safer Louisville Lower Taxes Legal Immigration Protecting The Unborn Protecting Women’s Sports

abortion.text: Her campaign lists protecting the unborn as one of its priorities, indicating opposition to abortion.
abortion.quote: Defending Capitalism Safer Louisville Lower Taxes Legal Immigration Protecting The Unborn Protecting Women’s Sports
